title: How do I add an athlete to augo?
seoTitle: Adding an Athlete to augo | augo support
description: How to invite an athlete to your augo roster and what happens on their side.
summary: You invite an athlete from your coach account, and they join by accepting the invitation in the augo mobile app. Once connected, they appear on your roster and their workouts flow in as soon as they link a device.
questionForms: how do i invite an athlete
how do i add someone to my roster
my athlete cant find the invite
how does my athlete join augo
how do i grow my roster
how do athletes accept an invitation

body.html: Note for the augo team: this article needs a walkthrough or screenshots of the real invite flow before publishing. The steps below describe the shape of the flow but have not been verified against the product.

Inviting an athlete

Invitations are sent from your coach account. The athlete receives an invitation and accepts it in the augo mobile app, which creates the coach–athlete link.

What the athlete does

They download augo from the App Store or Google Play, accept your invitation, and connect their device or app. Until that last step happens their training feed will be empty — see which devices and apps augo syncs with.

How many athletes you can add

Up to 2 athletes is free permanently. Beyond that you need the Unlimited plan — see what’s free and when you need to pay.

faqs.question: How many athletes can I have on the free plan?
faqs.answer: Two. The free tier is permanent rather than a trial, so you can coach two athletes on augo indefinitely without paying.

faqs.question: Why is my new athlete’s training feed empty?
faqs.answer: Almost always because they have joined but not yet connected a data source. The athlete has to link Garmin, Polar, Strava, Coros, Wahoo or Zwift from their own account — a coach cannot do it for them.
